posts.name: Drakossozh
posts.cooked:
Is it just me, or is TL Tachyon just crazy? Allowing all her teammates to draw a card every turn (more or less)....crazy. I just played a game with TL Tachyon, Bunker, and Haka, and we absolutely wiped the floor with Dawn; she never even got the chance to flip. Set up was crazy fast, as was charging up the Omni and Haka of Battle. Of course, TL wasn't all there offensively, but the support she provided more than made up for it.

Now of course, the team I had was heavily dependent on card draw, etc, but drawing more cards would benefit ANY hero.

Again, Team Leader Tachyon is just crazy.

Amazing how just changing one card (though of course, its the main one) can change the play style of certain heroes :))
